model: 81-wavelength finite-slab two-flux transport, 380-780 nm at 5 nm; CIE 1931/D65 color integration; appearance calibrated to existing BioSkin identity

layers.name: 角质屏障
layers.role: weakly absorbing keratin barrier; hydration drives micro-roughness

layers.name: 活性表皮
layers.role: melanin absorption filter above vascular tissue
layers.valueStatus: authored representative thickness; melanin coefficients from Jacques

layers.name: 乳头真皮
layers.role: superficial capillary absorption and collagen scattering
layers.valueStatus: authored regional value; Jacques discusses localized 2-5 percent blood near 100-200 micrometres

layers.name: 网状真皮
layers.role: deeper collagen scattering and softly filtered vascular field
layers.valueStatus: authored representative thickness and blood fraction

layers.name: 皮下组织
layers.role: low-absorption scattering backing; not a geometric fat-thickness estimate
layers.valueStatus: authored effective optical slab, not measured anatomy

surfaceFilm.valueStatus: representative rendering indices; film covers a bounded part of the surface

vermilion.backing: vascular muscle-rich connective tissue, not facial adipose
vermilion.film: independent aqueous wetness field; no facial T-zone sebum
vermilion.valueStatus: authored values; lip barrier and vascular differences are research-backed, these thicknesses are not donor measurements

regionalEstimates.status: smooth original model-space artistic fields; no measured individual vessel map or histological thickness map
regionalEstimates.thicknessOrder: eyelid and temple thinner than cheek; nose and forehead thicker
regionalEstimates.blood: distinct smoothly varying superficial and deep fractions, cheek/nose emphasis, no blood inside epidermis

boundaries: No new photographic textures or head meshes
No medical simulation or measured individual concentrations
Subcutaneous anatomy and vessels are estimated, not observed
Three representative wavelengths remain only in angular diffusion-width approximation; visible colors use 81-wavelength integration

calibration.type: relative spectral layer response with existing BioSkin neutral identity anchor
calibration.reference: natural tissue, relative thickness 1, baseline preset melanin/blood, no additional deep vessel
calibration.reason: Three-band direct color was gray/purple; absolute uncalibrated two-flux color was pale/olive. Neither is accepted as a faithful prediction.

colorimetry.browser: manual 4D interpolation, appended to existing 512-wide Float32 pore table, no extra sampler
